fact.en:
What are electromagnetic waves made of?

They are created by vibrations between an electric field and a magnetic field, so they are called electromagnetic waves!
fact.tl:
Saan gawa ang electromagnetic waves?

Nalilikha ang mga ito sa pag-vibrate ng electric field at magnetic field, kaya tinawag silang electromagnetic waves!
fact.bis:
Unsa ang naghimo sa electromagnetic waves?

Nahimo kini pinaagi sa pag-vibrate tali sa electric field ug magnetic field, mao nga gitawag sila ug electromagnetic waves!

cards.illustration: A glowing wave with an electric field arrow and a magnetic field arrow vibrating at right angles to each other.

fact.en: A changing electric field produces a magnetic field around it.
fact.tl: Ang nagbabagong electric field ay lumilikha ng magnetic field sa paligid nito.
fact.bis: Ang nag-usab nga electric field naghimo ug magnetic field sa iyang palibut.

cards.illustration: A wire with an electric current, showing invisible magnetic field lines looping around it.

fact.en: A changing magnetic field produces an electric field, an idea discovered by Michael Faraday.
fact.tl: Ang nagbabagong magnetic field ay lumilikha ng electric field, isang ideyang natuklasan ni Michael Faraday.
fact.bis: Ang nag-usab nga magnetic field naghimo ug electric field, usa ka ideya nga nadiskobrehan ni Michael Faraday.

cards.illustration: A magnet moving through a coil of wire, causing a small spark of electricity.

fact.en: Electromagnetic waves carry energy as they travel through space.
fact.tl: Ang electromagnetic waves ay nagdadala ng energy habang naglalakbay sa kalawakan.
fact.bis: Ang electromagnetic waves nagdala ug energy samtang nagbiyahe sa kawanangan.

cards.illustration: A glowing wave moving from the sun to a solar panel, with the panel lighting up.

fact.en:
Can electromagnetic waves travel through empty space?

Yes! They can travel through a vacuum, meaning they do not need any medium like air or water.
fact.tl:
Kaya bang maglakbay ng electromagnetic waves sa walang laman na space?

Oo! Kaya nilang maglakbay sa vacuum, ibig sabihin hindi nila kailangan ng medium tulad ng hangin o tubig.
fact.bis:
Makabiyahe ba ang electromagnetic waves sa walay sud nga space?

Oo! Makabiyahe sila sa vacuum, nagpasabot nga dili nila kinahanglan ang medium sama sa hangin o tubig.

cards.illustration: A wave moving from the sun through dark empty space to reach the Earth.

fact.en: In a vacuum, electromagnetic waves travel at a constant speed of 3x10^8 meters per second.
fact.tl: Sa vacuum, ang electromagnetic waves ay naglalakbay sa bilis na 3x10^8 metro bawat segundo.
fact.bis: Sa vacuum, ang electromagnetic waves mobiyahe sa gikusgon nga 3x10^8 metros kada segundo.

cards.illustration: A beam of light racing from the Earth to the Moon, with a small clock showing the time.

fact.en: The electromagnetic spectrum arranges all electromagnetic waves by their frequency and wavelength.
fact.tl: Ang electromagnetic spectrum ay nag-aayos ng lahat ng electromagnetic waves ayon sa kanilang frequency at wavelength.
fact.bis: Ang electromagnetic spectrum naghan-ay sa tanang electromagnetic waves pinaagi sa ilang frequency ug wavelength.

cards.illustration: A long horizontal line with seven colored sections, from long waves on the left to short waves on the right.

fact.en: The electromagnetic spectrum includes radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, and gamma rays.
fact.tl: Kasama sa electromagnetic spectrum ang radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, at gamma rays.
fact.bis: Ang electromagnetic spectrum naglakip sa radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, ug gamma rays.

cards.illustration: A rainbow-like spectrum with seven distinct bands, each labeled with a small icon like a radio tower or a lightbulb.

fact.en:
What happens to frequency when wavelength increases?

As wavelength increases, frequency decreases! They are like a seesaw, when one goes up, the other goes down.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa frequency kapag humaba ang wavelength?

Kapag humaba ang wavelength, bumababa ang frequency! Para silang seesaw, kapag tumaas ang isa, bumababa ang isa.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa frequency kon motaas ang wavelength?

Kon motaas ang wavelength, mous-os ang frequency! Sama sila sa seesaw, kon mosaka ang usa, mous-os ang usa.

cards.illustration: A seesaw with a long wave on one side and a short wave on the other side.

fact.en: Radio waves have the longest wavelength and the lowest frequency among all electromagnetic waves.
fact.tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamahabang wavelength at pinakamababang frequency sa lahat ng electromagnetic waves.
fact.bis: Ang radio waves adunay pinakataas nga wavelength ug pinakaubos nga frequency sa tanang electromagnetic waves.

cards.illustration: A tall radio tower sending out very long, gentle waves across a field.

fact.en: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelength, highest frequency, and highest energy among all electromagnetic waves.
fact.tl: Ang gamma rays ang may pinakamaikling wavelength, pinakamataas na frequency, at pinakamataas na energy sa lahat ng electromagnetic waves.
fact.bis: Ang gamma rays adunay pinakamubo nga wavelength, pinakataas nga frequency, ug pinakataas nga energy sa tanang electromagnetic waves.

cards.illustration: A tiny, intense burst of light from a star, with very short, jagged waves.

fact.en: Visible light is the only electromagnetic wave that can be seen by our naked eye.
fact.tl: Ang visible light ang tanging electromagnetic wave na nakikita ng ating mga mata.
fact.bis: Ang visible light mao lamang ang electromagnetic wave nga makita sa atong mga mata.

cards.illustration: A child's eye looking at a rainbow, with the colors of the rainbow reflecting in the eye.

fact.en:
Which color of visible light has the longest wavelength?

Red has the longest wavelength, while violet has the shortest wavelength and greatest frequency!
fact.tl:
Aling kulay ng visible light ang may pinakamahabang wavelength?

Ang pula ang may pinakamahabang wavelength, habang ang violet ang may pinakamaikling wavelength at pinakamataas na frequency!
fact.bis:
Unsa nga kolor sa visible light ang adunay pinakataas nga wavelength?

Ang pula adunay pinakataas nga wavelength, samtang ang violet adunay pinakamubo nga wavelength ug pinakataas nga frequency!

cards.illustration: A rainbow with red on the left side and violet on the right side, with a small ruler showing the wave lengths.

fact.en: Microwaves have wavelengths ranging from 1x10^-1 meters to 1x10^-3 meters, about the size of a coin.
fact.tl: Ang microwaves ay may wavelength mula 1x10^-1 metro hanggang 1x10^-3 metro, halos kasinglaki ng isang barya.
fact.bis: Ang microwaves adunay wavelength nga 1x10^-1 metros hangtod 1x10^-3 metros, sama kadako sa usa ka sensilyo.

cards.illustration: A one-peso coin next to a small wave pattern, showing the wave is about the same size as the coin.

fact.en: Infrared waves were discovered by astronomer Sir Frederick William Herschel and have wavelengths from 7x10^-7 meters to 1x10^-5 meters.
fact.tl: Ang infrared waves ay natuklasan ng astronomer na si Sir Frederick William Herschel at may wavelength mula 7x10^-7 metro hanggang 1x10^-5 metro.
fact.bis: Ang infrared waves nadiskobrehan sa astronomer nga si Sir Frederick William Herschel ug adunay wavelength nga 7x10^-7 metros hangtod 1x10^-5 metros.

cards.illustration: A scientist holding a prism, with a thermometer showing heat just beyond the red light.

fact.en: Ultraviolet radiation has a frequency range of 7.5x10^14 Hz to 3x10^16 Hz.
fact.tl: Ang ultraviolet radiation ay may frequency range na 7.5x10^14 Hz hanggang 3x10^16 Hz.
fact.bis: Ang ultraviolet radiation adunay frequency range nga 7.5x10^14 Hz hangtod 3x10^16 Hz.

cards.illustration: A wave pattern with very short, close-together peaks, labeled with a small sun icon.

fact.en: X-rays have wavelengths ranging from 1x10^-11 meters to 1x10^-8 meters.
fact.tl: Ang X-rays ay may wavelength mula 1x10^-11 metro hanggang 1x10^-8 metro.
fact.bis: Ang X-rays adunay wavelength nga 1x10^-11 metros hangtod 1x10^-8 metros.

cards.illustration: A medical X-ray image of a hand, with a small wave pattern showing very short waves.

fact.en:
Which EM wave has the most energy?

Gamma rays have the most energy because they have the highest frequency! Higher frequency means higher energy.
fact.tl:
Aling EM wave ang may pinakamaraming energy?

Ang gamma rays ang may pinakamaraming energy dahil sila ang may pinakamataas na frequency! Ang mas mataas na frequency ay nangangahulugan ng mas mataas na energy.
fact.bis:
Unsa nga EM wave ang adunay pinakadaghang energy?

Ang gamma rays adunay pinakadaghang energy tungod kay sila adunay pinakataas nga frequency! Ang mas taas nga frequency nagpasabot ug mas taas nga energy.

cards.illustration: A gamma ray burst from a star, with a bright glow showing its high energy.

fact.en: Radio waves have the lowest energy among all electromagnetic waves because they have the lowest frequency.
fact.tl: Ang radio waves ang may pinakamababang energy sa lahat ng electromagnetic waves dahil sila ang may pinakamababang frequency.
fact.bis: Ang radio waves adunay pinakaubos nga energy sa tanang electromagnetic waves tungod kay sila adunay pinakaubos nga frequency.

cards.illustration: A radio tower with very long, gentle waves, showing a small energy symbol.

fact.en:
What happens to energy when wavelength decreases?

As wavelength decreases, energy increases! Short waves pack more energy than long waves.
fact.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa energy kapag umiikli ang wavelength?

Kapag umiikli ang wavelength, tumataas ang energy! Ang maiikling waves ay may mas maraming energy kaysa mahahabang waves.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa energy kon mubo ang wavelength?

Kon mubo ang wavelength, motaas ang energy! Ang mugbo nga waves adunay mas daghang energy kaysa tag-as nga waves.

cards.illustration: Two waves side by side, one long and gentle, one short and intense, with energy symbols showing the short wave has more energy.

fact.en: In order of increasing frequency, the EM spectrum is radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, and gamma rays.
fact.tl: Sa pagkakasunod-sunod ng pagtaas ng frequency, ang EM spectrum ay radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, at gamma rays.
fact.bis: Sa han-ay sa pagtaas sa frequency, ang EM spectrum mao ang radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-rays, ug gamma rays.

cards.illustration: A line of seven colored blocks, each with a small icon, arranged from left to right with increasing frequency.

fact.en: Visible light ranges from red to violet, with red having the longest wavelength and violet having the shortest.
fact.tl: Ang visible light ay mula pula hanggang violet, kung saan ang pula ang may pinakamahabang wavelength at ang violet ang may pinakamaikli.
fact.bis: Ang visible light magsugod sa pula hangtod sa violet, diin ang pula adunay pinakataas nga wavelength ug ang violet adunay pinakamubo.

cards.illustration: A rainbow with red on one end and violet on the other, with a small arrow showing the wavelength getting shorter.

fact.en:
How are electromagnetic waves created?

They are created when an electrically charged object vibrates back and forth, producing changing electric and magnetic fields!
fact.tl:
Paano nalilikha ang electromagnetic waves?

Nalilikha ang mga ito kapag ang isang bagay na may electric charge ay nag-vibrate pabalik-balik, na lumilikha ng nagbabagong electric at magnetic fields!
fact.bis:
Giunsa paghimo ang electromagnetic waves?

Nahimo kini kon ang usa ka butang nga adunay electric charge mag-vibrate pabalik-balik, nga naghimo ug nag-usab nga electric ug magnetic fields!

cards.illustration: A charged particle moving back and forth, with waves radiating outward from it.

fact.en: As you move from radio waves to gamma rays in the electromagnetic spectrum, wavelength decreases while frequency and energy increase.
fact.tl: Habang lumilipat ka mula radio waves patungong gamma rays sa electromagnetic spectrum, bumababa ang wavelength habang tumataas ang frequency at energy.
fact.bis: Samtang molihok ka gikan sa radio waves ngadto sa gamma rays sa electromagnetic spectrum, mous-os ang wavelength samtang motaas ang frequency ug energy.

cards.illustration: A spectrum with long waves on the left and short waves on the right, with arrows showing the changes in wavelength, frequency, and energy.
